scope: Local four-ABI package and narrow Android32 runtime evidence; no full Monstera parity, physical ARM device, 16KiB runtime, distribution or legal certification

certificate.build: manual SDK build; resource-free AAR; not an AGP build

armeabi-v7a.execution: ARM32 via installed image native bridge

limits: Existing x86_64 and arm64-v8a JNI bytes reused with checked unchanged native source and recorded C/header/static archive hashes; both 32-bit providers/Rust/JNI built fresh.
All 16 ELF LOAD segments align to 16384, but actual API30 runtime pages were 4096. The separate existing 16KiB consumer gate was not changed or replaced.
ARM32 runs on the installed x86_64 API30 emulator through libndk_translation.so, not a physical ARM device.

Raw JNI fixture tests protected storage, atomic marker rollback, partial patch, i64, alias mapping, pending writes, forgetting and restart. It does not prove Kotlin/RN API or full Monstera UI behavior.
Optional coexistence used exact Monstera default-visible Watermelon SQLite C and Java fixture files read-only. Actual key-module behavior is owned by the separate Monstera lane.
Initial probe compile used nonexistent android-37/android.jar; corrected fixture path to installed android-37.0/android.jar. Native implementation and acceptance assertions unchanged.

Prior Apple notice unit suite had two HEAD-reproduced synthetic fixture failures (AN02BuildOrchestration test_build_artifacts_always_finalizes_notices and test_build_artifacts_fails_without_a_valid_corpus); no unrelated test or checker changed.
No new dependency download, no commit, no publishing. Historical evidence and accepted two-ABI Maven retained.
